text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After finishing training with Bubble Gum Fellow,
we were packing up when—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ayabe-san, would you like to run with us if you don't mind!? We want to practice racing tactics!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to see you run from behind, and
I thought it'd be better for everyone to run together anyway!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: If it's not a bother, that is...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Sure, sounds good.
I'd like to study how betwixt and front runners run, too.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...They're wonderful, aren't they?
So earnest, so pure in their passion for running.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I can't afford to lose either.
In fact, I'd love to jump in so we can push each other higher.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer-san, do you mind if I keep pushing myself just a little bit more?
choice_data_list: Go ahead and give it everything you've got.
Any more than this will lead to overworking.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: If I had to describe how I feel right now... well, it's like popping in a fresh, new flavor of gum.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Inspired by Special Week and the others,
Bubble Gum Fellow trained diligently until late at night.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I told her that she should channel those boiling feelings
into her next race or training session.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Guess I got a little too eager, huh.
All right, I'll save this feeling for later.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Instead, make sure you prepare a proper place for me to vent my feelings, okay?
